ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamental principles and techniques of software development. Design, documentation, testing, and debugging software, with a significant emphasis on code review. Credit is not given for both CS 242 and CS 126. Prerequisite: CS 125. Restricted to ENGINEERING UNDECLARED ONLY. This section will not open to any other major or minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Undeclared major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
